concept.title: Giving or receiving care
concept.shortdesc: Being an unpaid carer for someone who needs help, or receiving paid or unpaid care yourself.

keywords.keyword: do I qualify as a carer

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: must provide unpaid care for a friend or family member

care packages vary with personal need

living alone or housebound: see (living situation, not care)

section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed. The group re-formed in most resamplings of the data (stability 0.81).
Provider-concentrated: one organisation holds 62%. It may be one organisation's wording rather than a real category.
Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. Split into people who provide unpaid care to someone and people who receive paid or unpaid care.

section.p: Identifier in this run: elig-025. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
